d: Join Snoonu as an Employee Relations Lead – Onboarding & Offboarding, where you will lead and oversee the end-to-end employee onboarding and offboarding processes across Snoonu Fleet, ensuring a seamless, efficient, compliant, and positive employee lifecycle experience. You will be responsible for managing onboarding and offboarding operations and ensuring that employee documentation, employment formalities, system updates, clearances, and related administrative requirements are completed accurately and within established timelines. Working closely with Talent Acquisition, PRO, Payroll, Finance, IT, Fleet Operations, and other relevant stakeholders, you will ensure that new joiners are properly integrated into the business and employee exits are managed professionally, with all legal, financial, and operational requirements fulfilled. The role requires strong leadership, operational follow-up, stakeholder coordination, and process improvement capabilities to support Fleet's large and continuously evolving workforce while maintaining compliance with Qatar Labour Law and Snoonu's internal policies.
q: Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field.
5–7 years of experience in Employee Relations, HR Operations, onboarding, offboarding, or employee lifecycle management, preferably within a large-scale or operational workforce environment.
Previous experience leading or supervising a team is strongly preferred.
Strong understanding of employee onboarding and offboarding processes, employment documentation, final settlements, employee clearances, and HR administration.
Good knowledge of Qatar Labour Law, employment regulations, and relevant government procedures.
Experience coordinating with Payroll, Finance, PRO, Talent Acquisition, and Operations teams.
Strong leadership, organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Excellent problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and the ability to prioritize multiple operational requirements.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, and HRIS platforms such as Keka or similar systems.
High level of professionalism, accountability, integrity, and confidentiality.
Fluency in English is required; Arabic is considered an advantage.

d: Eden Rose is currently engaged with a financial institution based in the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC) who are seeking an Operations Manager to join their team.

Reporting to the Executive Director, you will oversee the firm's day-to-day operational activities, ensuring effective processes, robust internal controls and adherence to applicable DFSA regulatory requirements.
r: Oversee the day-to-day operational activities of the firm, ensuring efficient and effective investment management operations.
Manage and coordinate fund and investment operations, including trade processing, settlements, reconciliations and transaction monitoring from an operational perspective.
Oversee relationships with external service providers, including fund administrators, custodians, brokers and other relevant counterparties.
Oversee fund administration activities, including NAV calculations, valuations, subscriptions, redemptions and associated reconciliations, where applicable.
Ensure operational policies, procedures, systems and controls are maintained in accordance with internal requirements and applicable DFSA regulations.
Identify, assess and mitigate operational risks, ensuring appropriate controls and escalation procedures are in place.
Work closely with Finance, Compliance, Investment Management and senior management to ensure effective coordination across business functions.
Oversee operational reporting, maintain accurate records and support internal and external audits and regulatory reviews.
Identify opportunities to streamline processes, enhance operational efficiency and implement improvements to systems and procedures.
Support the implementation of new business initiatives, investment products and operational projects.
Provide operational updates and management information to senior management, highlighting key risks, challenges and areas for improvement.

The Operations Manager will hold a Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Economics or a related discipline. You will have a minimum 7–10 years' relevant experience within investment management, asset management, fund management or financial services operations and previous experience in an Operations Manager or senior investment operations role within a regulated financial institution. Experience working within a DIFC/DFSA-regulated environment is highly desirable; ADGM/FSRA or comparable regulatory experience will also be considered.

You will have a strong understanding of investment and fund operations, including trade lifecycle management, settlements, reconciliations and oversight of external service providers. You will have experience coordinating with fund administrators, custodians, brokers, auditors and other external stakeholders.

This position offers an excellent opportunity for an experienced professional to take ownership of the operations function. Please apply now or for further information contact Kayte Short at Eden Rose at kayte.short@edenrose.ae

d: The role covers the region Middle East and Africa (MEA), possibility to extend to Türkiye at a later stage. You will operate out of our office in Riyadh (KSA ) or Dubai (UAE)).

The Senior Compliance Officer acts as a member of the Legal & Compliance Department (L&C). The Senior Compliance Officer materially contributes to building, implementing, and managing the health care compliance and the distribution management program of Terumo Europe (TE) in the MEA region. The Senior Compliance Officer acts as the first point of contact for Business Units (BU’s ),Countries in the region and Functions for healthcare compliance and distributor management matters (due diligence). The Senior Compliance Officer contributes to one or more Centre of Excellence.

He/she applies extensive knowledge and expertise in health care compliance, anti-bribery and distribution management and leads a consistent implementation of the TE compliance program in its region to the different BU’S and countries through day-to-day advice, training, monitoring, audits and reporting. Handles and coordinates day-to-day legal matters in its cluster under supervision of a Senior legal counsel.
In its role the Senior Compliance Officer will report to the Terumo Europe headquarter, more concretely to the Senior Legal Counsel responsible for the META region
Leads one or more compliance projects and contributes to centres of excellence EMEA wide , such as improving compliance processes and procedures, drafting policies or automation.
r: You actively participate in compliance and team meetings, bringing relevant topics for discussion. Uphold high ethical standards and confidentiality. Collaborate effectively within the matrix organization (BU and countries), resolving overlaps and sharing information. Contribute to compliance programs, develop deliverables, and manage assigned projects. Build relationships within the company, conveying risk evaluations and policies. Network outside the company, representing it in industry associations and government bodies. Regularly and consistently report on responsibilities and handle contract administration using digital tools.
You are the point of contact for the countries under your responsibility, for first line legal and compliance matters.

Be an expert on local anti-bribery regulations, healthcare compliance, and distributor management. Share knowledge with compliance officers and the team. Stay informed about relevant laws and propose actions.

Identify training needs and educate associates on Terumo’s compliance program and policies, focusing on local regulations. Advice on HCC and distribution management, review and approve HCP/HCO interactions, perform transparency reporting, and conduct compliance reviews.

Manage the distribution process for all businesses in MEA. Develop and provide training , handle contract management and guide businesses in daily distributor due diligence. Review and advise on due diligence reports, collaborating closely with other compliance officers and legal counsel.

Perform regular risk assessments and monitor local compliance programs, suggesting improvements. Conduct internal investigations and support audits. Fulfill transparency reporting requirements. Provide timely input for reporting to Terumo Corporation and other necessary reporting requirements.

Contribute to or lead EMEA-wide compliance projects and working groups (e.g., HCP Consultancy, Transparency Reporting, Monitoring). When leading a COE, design and manage the program, perform and coordinate monitoring activities, recommend improvements, and collaborate with compliance officers and team members to implement enhancements.
Coordinate various legal matters in Cluster MEA with Senior Legal Counsel, including contracts and corporate issues.
Master’s degree in law, preferably a degree in Compliance
Minimum 5 years on the job experience in Healthcare Compliance
Good level of IT with Microsoft office skills
Fluent in English, Arabic (written and spoken) considered a plus.
You live in in Saudi Arabia or in the Middle East region.
Excellent interpersonal relationship skills including negotiating and relationship management with ability to drive achievement of objectives
Excellent moral compass, masters values integrity, respect, care
Team player that can implement compliant solutions to business needs
Good responsiveness to priorities, strategic and problem-solving
A self-starter who is able to function in an individual contributor role as well as in the capacity of counsellor to others
Decision-making ability, with a focus on helping the company achieve its strategic business objectives while managing the legal risks and liability involved
Expert understanding of procedures while looking beyond existing methodologies and own discipline to define and resolve complex problems and with a focus on continuous improvement
Expert knowledge of Industry Code requirements
Ability to perform assignments with skill, knowledge and a high degree of independence
x: Working for Terumo means contributing to society through healthcare.
